_comment: The owner's server decisions of 2026-10-25 (docs/decisions/0007-server-rules.md; Decisions sheet 1, cards srv-*). This is the file the friends' server is built with: py -3.10 tools/server/build_play_server.py --java25 --instance %APPDATA%\.crazycraft4 --out C:\qfs\friends --force --opis --rules tools/server/rules.json (no --world-border). Keys starting with _ are ignored; every other key is explained in rules.example.json and in docs/setup/hosting-a-server.md, 'The owner's decisions'.
_srv-pvp: Leave PvP as it is: no team, friendly fire stays, the Gravity Gun unchanged. 'Even if we add team functionality, I think friendly fire is a part of the game too.'
_srv-quests: Personal progression: no BetterQuesting parties (party_enable=0). 'Everyone has their own quests and their own rewards.'
_srv-sleep: The night skips when half the players, rounded down, are in bed. Morpheus has one knob, SleeperPerc: it skips when floor(100 * sleepers / counted players) >= SleeperPerc. 43 gives floor(n/2) for 2, 4, 6 and every count from 8 to 15, and asks one more (half rounded up: 2 of 3, 3 of 5, 4 of 7) for 3, 5 and 7 players; no single percentage does better, and 50 would ask half rounded up at every odd count. Players below y=64 (GroundLevel, IncludeMiners default) are not counted, and one sleeper is enough when nobody else counts.
_srv-afk: Idle kick after 30 minutes. Deliberate AFK set-ups (a water loop) are fine.
_srv-hub: A hub at spawn, spawn-protection 16: non-ops cannot place or break within 16 blocks of the spawn point, overworld only, vanilla block actions only.
_srv-loaders: The whole bundle: Railcraft World Anchors not craftable (Personal and Passive stay), Sync shells do not keep chunks loaded, an operator's ChickenChunks loaders stop while he is offline.
_srv-graves: Accept the defaults, written down. No grave rule in the post: 'It's an honor based world with an honor based system.' This key changes nothing on the server.
_srv-tools: The rest of the bundle: Chest Transporters cannot carry mob spawners, the Watch of Flowing Time gives machines no pedestal bonus, Lycanites random mob events only from day 3. Opis is --opis on the command line; the world border is not applied (the outskirts are end-game territory, decision 0003).
